item.title: Koisuru Koto to Mitsuketari!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fizz
  • 発売日: 2011-12-22
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋するコトと見つけたり！
  • 英語名: Koisuru Koto to Mitsuketari!

あらすじ

The story starts off with our protagonist Kyou waking up to 2 girls lying on top of him and teasing him, and they both end up kissing him on the cheek. However, he then wakes up in the student council room where student council president Mira finds him and reminds him of the meeting. After said meeting, Kyou attends an assembly where Mira announces that all the students should strive to find love this year but anyone who wants to lay their hands on Kyou needs to go through her first! It seems the two girls from the beginning, Yukina and Towa, are Kyou’s fiancées. As more girls join in, the fight for Kyou’s love begins!

item.title: Sakura no Shippo ~Sakura Tale Fandisc~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fizz
  • 発売日: 2010-11-26
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくらのしっぽ～さくらテイルファンディスク～
  • 英語名: Sakura no Shippo Sakura Tale Fandisc

あらすじ

This is the fandisk to Sakura Tale. It features after stories for each of the 6 heroines from the original game, as well a route for Natsumi. There’s also an extra story featuring a crossover with Asanagi no Aquanauts, however characters from that game will not show up.

[From Hau~ Omochikaeri!]

item.title: Sakura Tale
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fizz
  • 発売日: 2009-10-30
  • スコア: 6.659999999999999/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: さくらテイル
  • 英語名: Sakura Tale

别名

  • the tale of cherry blossom septet

あらすじ

Masamune has just started his school life, but he soon gets involved in a recruiting battle by sports clubs. What saves him is a girl in strange clothing. He is attracted to her, but he meets another girl who looks totally different a few days later.

Light and darkness. He meets his childhood friend at the school dormitory, but she has completely changed.

别名

  • Aquanauts of a Morning Calm

あらすじ

One day, a girl asks Aki, the main character, to come out behind school building after school. He never expected such a thing would happen to him. Her name is Mio. She is a little bit strange, but pretty enough.

“She’ll tell me she loves me!” But he is wrong….

あらすじ

Tokiya and his cousin Mashiro, are high school students. One day, a transfer student joins his class. Her name is also Mashiro. He is surprised to see her, because he met her a couple of days before. Mashiro asks, “Do you know her?”

“Hmm… yeah….”

“…?”

We met in January, the coldest time of the year…

item.title: Koimomo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fizz
  • 発売日: 2005-11-25
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋もも
  • 英語名: Koimomo

あらすじ

Kazuki’s parents often traveled abroad, so he was raised most of the time with the Tokizawas, distant relatives of his. There he was raised like a son along with Hazuki, the Tokizawa’s daughter. However, his peaceful life is about to be shattered when, while he’s staying with the Tokizawas during his parents’ long business trip, a mysterious girl called Momoka appears and says she will “protect Kazuki’s life”.
